blurb: Guests can enjoy private or shared airboat tours lasting 60 or 90 minutes exploring nature where other boats can't go. Pontoon boat rentals are available for half or full day to cruise to Homosassa Springs and visit waterfront restaurants. Boat tours include manatee tours, dolphin tours, eco tours, and custom tours along the Homosassa River and Gulf of Mexico.
